P Q : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)
hPQ : ∀ j ≤ i, P j = Q j
⊢ A (op869_graph_from_predecessors P) i = A (op869_graph_from_predecessors Q) i
j ≤ i → l ≤ i → ((op869_graph_from_predecessors P).Adj j l ↔ (op869_graph_from_predecessors Q).Adj j l)
⊢ (op869_graph_from_predecessors P).Adj j l ↔ (op869_graph_from_predecessors Q).Adj j l
